payload.reason: The evidence provides specific comparisons of the proposed models against LSTM and transformer baselines, indicating the performance improvements achieved with ReWE and ReSE.

claims.text: The models with ReWE outperformed the LSTM and transformer baselines consistently across different datasets.
In experiments with the LSTM, both ReWE and ReWE+ReSE outperformed the baseline at word level, although results varied with BPE.
ReWE and ReSE can outperform strong state-of-the-art baseline models based on LSTMs and transformers.
